message.content:
In Flappy Bird the very first “score” you see when you start a new game is 0.  
That’s the lowest possible score you can achieve in a single playthrough.  

If you were asking about the lowest score ever recorded by a player, I don’t have that data on hand—my current tools only let me fetch the highest score for a given game. Let me know if you’d like me to look up the top score instead!
